newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady-lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady-lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels in bids and offers on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Wednesday. Bids and offers included;
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River (McGregor and south), next week bid at a steady 115 percent of tariff, offered 2-1/2 points lower at 120 pct.
- Two barges, Mississippi River (St. Paul through Savage) next week, offered at 110 pct, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week July, bid steady at 105 pct, offered five points lower at 110 pct.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi River, one each week July, offered at 120 pct, no bid or comparison.
- Five barges, Illinois River, one each week August, bid 2-1/2 points lower at 112-1/2 pct, no offer.
